name: flat-cartoon
title: Flat cartoon
summary: Flat-vector science explainer look: deep violet grounds, one glowing key light, four-layer cel shading with rim light and grain, generated scenery plates under a code-drawn, code-animated character and light.

look.ground: vertical violet gradients (space, dusk, night); never black

palette.where: top of every sky, darkest colour

look.type: Montserrat 800 titles and captions; Nunito 800 in pill labels
look.texture: animated film grain at 6 %, violet vignette
look.light: one key light per scene, usually in frame; low and from the left in the example; soft blurred halos and ray wedges
look.materials: flat cel shading: base, shadow crescent shifted away from the light, blurred highlight, warm rim; no outlines

consistency: the character is one SVG rig reused in every shot; scenery plates are generated per depth with one shared style block and the same light direction; light, sky and stars are code so they match across plates

motion.feel: slow continuous camera drift with elastic pops for new information
moves: camera push: scale 1 → 1.06-1.08 over the shot, sine.inOut
label pop: scale 0 → 1 in 0.42 s, back.out(1.8), 0.1 s stagger
event: anticipation swell 1 → 1.12 in 0.4 s, collapse to 0 in 0.3 s back.in(2.2), flash bloom
character take: squash 0.95 → stretch 1.05 → elastic.out settle, head leads by 0.06 s
parallax: far +16 px, mid +6 px, near -8 px, foreground -40 px over the shot

pace.text: a new element every 1-3 s inside each shot; labels ≥ 0.8 s, captions held to the end of the shot

banned: pure black, neutral grey, black outlines
characters or text inside generated plates
warm baked rim light after the light goes out
characters, logos or looks taken from an existing channel

generators: GPT Image 2.6 (Higgsfield), three transparent 16:9 plates, prompts in project/tools/layers.md

source: studied from the general look of flat-vector science channels (frames analysed, none used)
